meta.title: Questions / information / answers register - Session O
meta.rule: No strategy is final until every P1 item is answered from a document, not from memory. Status: ANSWERED = official evidence in hand; PARTIAL = area-level evidence only; OPEN = document still required.

questions.question: What is the exact lease expiration date, and are there renewal options (count, length, rent formula)?
questions.have: Brief range only: 2030-2035.
questions.need: Recorded lease + all amendments; tenant estoppel certificate.
questions.how: Title company / owner files; estoppel request to tenant per lease terms.
questions.blocked: All timing, expiry-grid pricing, extension strategy

questions.question: What are current rent, escalations (fixed/CPI), percentage rent, and tax/insurance/CAM pass-throughs (true NNN?)
questions.have: Nothing. No rent in brief.
questions.need: Lease abstract by counsel; rent roll; 3 years of NNN reconciliation statements.
questions.how: Owner files; property manager ledger.
questions.blocked: NOI, valuation, coverage, model dollar outputs

questions.question: Guarantor? Assignment/sublet, dark-store, relocation, termination, ROFR/ROFO, purchase-option clauses?
questions.have: Nothing.
questions.need: Clause-by-clause lease abstract.
questions.how: Counsel review of recorded lease.
questions.blocked: Whether extension/sale can be negotiated at all

questions.question: Is the parcel inside the City of Los Angeles (Measure ULA) and what are APN, lot size, zoning, drive-thru entitlement status?
questions.have: 'Around central Los Angeles' only (intentionally vague).
questions.need: Preliminary title report; ZIMAS zoning printout; certificate of occupancy.
questions.how: Title company; LA City ZIMAS (public, needs address privately).
questions.blocked: ULA tax (M35), redevelopment option, land residual

questions.question: What are this store's sales, trend, and rent coverage (sales / rent)? Any tenant closure-list or remodel signals?
questions.have: System data only: SSS -1.1% Q3 FY26, -4.2% YTD; system shrank 2168 to 2115 in a year (M29-M31).
questions.need: Tenant sales reports (lease audit right); broker intel; site visit / photo log.
questions.how: Lease audit clause; tenant estoppel interview.
questions.blocked: Renewal probability - the single largest model input

questions.question: What are JACK total debt, leverage, and equity deficit on one consistent definition at Jul 5 2026?
questions.have: System counts and SSS verified (M29-M31); debt left blank (B08) due to definition conflicts.
questions.need: 10-Q balance sheet + debt footnote read directly; rating-agency actions if any.
questions.how: SEC EDGAR S08 direct read; auditor-confirmed figures.
questions.blocked: Tenant-credit haircut in cap-rate spread

questions.question: Is the trade area gaining or losing QSR demand (population, income, jobs within 1/3/5 miles)?
questions.have: City/county: population -0.8%/-3.2% since 2020; county jobs +0.4% YoY; unemployment 4.4-4.8% (M01-M04, M21-M23).
questions.need: Ring study after address is supplied privately; never publish rings with address.
questions.how: Census ACS tract pull (private workbook only).
questions.blocked: Site-level demand projection

questions.question: What does DOF Vintage 2026 P-2A project for LA County in 2030/2035/2040?
questions.have: Conflicting secondary reports (9.3M vs 9,637,524 for 2040). No number published (B06).
questions.need: P-2A Vintage 2026 workbook downloaded from DOF.
questions.how: dof.ca.gov Demographics (S15) - free Excel.
questions.blocked: Long-hold demand case

questions.question: What is official LAUSD enrollment trend and the assigned schools' condition for this trade area?
questions.have: Census attainment only (M11-M14). LAUSD count blank (B05).
questions.need: LAUSD Norm-Day / REF enrollment report; school report cards (CA Dashboard).
questions.how: lausd.org; caschooldashboard.org after address supplied privately.
questions.blocked: Family-demand narrative only (not a pricing input alone)

questions.question: What cap rate / price do buyers actually pay for Jack in the Box NNN with 4-9 vs 10-15 years of term?
questions.have: No official cap-rate source exists (B07). Treasury anchor 4.88% (M28).
questions.need: Closed NNN comps (tenant, term, rent, cap) + 2 broker BOVs.
questions.how: Brokers under NDA with rent provided privately; never publish rent.
questions.blocked: Every dollar valuation; breakeven cap in model

questions.question: Parcel FHSZ, fault, liquefaction, flood zones? Current premium, FAIR Plan exposure, EQ quote?
questions.have: Regional: USGS 60% M6.7+ / 30 yrs; Jan 2025 fires destroyed 16,251 structures county-wide (M39-M41).
questions.need: APN-based CAL FIRE FHSZ, CGS, FEMA FIRM lookups; insurance broker quotes.
questions.how: Private APN lookup; broker market check.
questions.blocked: Insurance-cost and tail-risk pricing for hold case

questions.question: Roof/HVAC/parking/drive-thru condition; who pays under NNN? Deferred capex before a sale or extension?
questions.have: Nothing. 'NNN' in brief is unverified until Q-02 confirms pass-throughs.
questions.need: Property condition assessment; lease maintenance matrix.
questions.how: Inspector engagement (private report).
questions.blocked: Net sale proceeds; extension TI/LC budget

questions.question: What is market (replacement) rent for this box if vacant, and re-tenant downtime / TI / leasing cost?
questions.have: Nothing site-specific.
questions.need: Retail leasing comps for comparable QSR pads in central LA.
questions.how: Leasing broker survey (private).
questions.blocked: Dark-value floor in model (Strategy C/D downside)

questions.question: Sale taxes: city base + county documentary + ULA cliff at actual price; broker/legal costs?
questions.have: ULA 4%/5.5% above $5.4M/$10.9M (post Jun 30 2026) and city base 0.45% verified (M35-M36).
questions.need: Price-dependent computation once Q-10 prices the asset; county rate confirmation.
questions.how: LA Finance FAQ S12 + escrow estimate.
questions.blocked: Net proceeds at prices above $5.4M

questions.question: Owner basis, accumulated depreciation, loan payoff, bracket - what is after-tax, after-debt proceeds per path?
questions.have: Never collected (B09, privacy rule).
questions.need: Private tax worksheet completed offline with CPA.
questions.how: CPA engagement; do not email or commit figures.
questions.blocked: Any after-tax ranking, 1031 sizing

questions.question: Existing loan: balance, rate, maturity, prepayment / defeasance, assumability?
questions.have: Nothing.
questions.need: Note + latest loan statement (private).
questions.how: Owner files / servicer.
questions.blocked: Net equity, sell timing

questions.question: Prop 13 assessed value today vs market value - how large is the hold subsidy lost on exchange?
questions.have: Rule verified: 2% cap, reset on change of ownership (M37). Amounts unknown.
questions.need: County assessor assessed-value history (private, APN).
questions.how: Assessor lookup after APN supplied privately.
questions.blocked: Hold-vs-exchange tax comparison

questions.question: 1031 mechanics: intermediary, 45-day ID / 180-day close, CA conformity, replacement universe & yields?
questions.have: Federal scope verified (M38, S13). Deadlines to confirm with counsel.
questions.need: QI engagement letter; replacement pipeline with verified rents (private).
questions.how: QI + tax counsel; broker pipeline.
questions.blocked: Strategy A/B execution readiness

questions.question: Owner horizon, income need, risk tolerance, concentration limit for single-tenant exposure?
questions.have: Brief goal only: preservation + growth, manageable risk.
questions.need: One-page private owner policy statement (offline).
questions.how: Owner completes private worksheet; store offline only.
questions.blocked: Final path selection among near-tied strategies

questions.question: Who approves suggestions before anything is implemented?
questions.have: This workbook's Suggestions page is built for review-and-choose; nothing auto-implements.
questions.need: Owner marks Accept / Modify / Reject + date per suggestion (print or private copy).
questions.how: Suggestions page checklist (session-6596c3f2/suggestions.html).
questions.blocked: Governance - prevents accidental execution
